name: AIUserBubble
description: AIUserBubble renders a right-aligned message pill representing the user's sent text. Two surface variants: light (default) uses a gray (#E8E6ED) surface for chat threads on dark or brand backgrounds; dark uses a deep indigo (#1F2A66 / AI_RAMP[100]) fill with white text for use on white or light-gray surfaces. Both achieve WCAG AAA contrast ratios. The bubble uses Open Sans at 16px (default) or 14px (medium) with 1.55–1.4 line-height and max-width of 82%.
intent: Message container for the human user's input in a conversational AI interface. Visually distinct from AI-generated responses — positioned right-aligned with a light fill.

keyboard: Ensure keyboard focus order matches visual order

usage: Use to represent every user-sent message in the AI chat thread
Use in AICommandCenter's message thread mapped over role:"user" entries
doNotUse: Do not use for AI responses — those use AIResponsePatterns
Do not customize the background or border-radius outside the token specification
Do not invent dependency atomics — use bundled canonical sources
Do not hardcode brand hex — use AI tokens
Do not require an external AI UI package for agent implementations — use co-located TSX
